purpose: Create and audit current-calibration Chandra event, exposure, PSF, blank-sky, and response products for RX J2129 without fitting a gas-density profile, a gas mass, or any gravity response.
disclosure: Before this freeze, the archive event-adequacy audit had passed on the standard evt2 products: ObsIDs 9370 and 552 provide 39.604096 ks, 1434 combined 0.7-2.0 keV events inside 5 arcsec, four raw inner-annulus counts of 114, 275, 513, and 532, a 0.372-arcsec soft centroid offset, and a 0.243-arcsec smoothed-peak offset. No CIAO-reprocessed event count, flare-filtered exposure, blank-sky scale, center PSF size, response, calibrated spectrum, gas-density parameter, gas mass, gravity residual, or independent lens residual had been inspected.

software.installation_source: official CXC conda channel with conda-forge dependencies

frozen_center.origin: same BCG center used by the dynamics, baryonic, and lens-observable protocols

reprocessing.afterglow_and_status_filtering: chandra_repro defaults recorded by tool logs

blank_sky.scaling_source: per-chip BKGSCALn keywords computed by blanksky
blank_sky.spectral_caveat: Retain unscaled background events and BKGSCALn/AREASCAL metadata; do not background-subtract a PHA with modified AREASCAL. The later Poisson likelihood must model source and background counts explicitly.
blank_sky.soft_galactic_component: required nuisance in the subsequent spectral likelihood, not estimated during reduction

point_source_detection.note: The source list is a preprocessing product. The central 10 arcsec is never masked as a point source; any unresolved central source is a PSF-convolved nuisance in the later spatial likelihood.

spectra.rule: The diagnostic annuli are not automatically independent temperature bins. If an annulus has fewer than 1500 source-band counts, it may constrain the projected spatial count likelihood but must share temperature/emissivity parameters or be combined under a separately frozen spectral model.

reduction_advance_thresholds.comparison_definition: For each inner annulus compare exposure-normalized soft counts after blank-sky scaling; use |rate_552-rate_9370| divided by their inverse-variance pooled rate. The threshold is an instrument/reduction compatibility screen, not a gas-model fit.

failure_rules.software_or_calibration_mismatch: Stop; do not substitute standard archive evt2 products for calibrated inference.
failure_rules.exposure_or_blank_sky_failure: Stop the gas reconstruction and preserve the public-data/reduction shortfall.
failure_rules.psf_failure: Do not claim four independent inner gas nodes; require a lower-dimensional PSF-forward spatial model or another pilot.
failure_rules.observation_compatibility_failure: Do not coadd the observations. Diagnose time-dependent background, astrometry, and PSF effects under a separately frozen protocol.
failure_rules.pass: Freeze the projected spatial-plus-spectral Poisson gas model before inspecting any fitted density or mass. Passing reduction alone does not authorize a gas profile or Weyl/dynamical response.
